user_scope: Continue autonomously toward accepted and activated Proofbase, superseding one-attempt/no-second-cycle/stop-on-candidate-failure restrictions. Diagnose and correct failures; focused checks before broader paid runs. Stop only at completion, insufficient safe budget for necessary next step, or concrete external blocker. No unrelated roadmap work.
stage_allocation_policy: Unused allocations may be redistributed. Each prepared stage explicitly reserves its complete conservative payload/call estimate from the shared remaining ceiling before execution; every request also reserves before submission. Reservations are released only against valid receipts. Do not reduce output allowances or coverage to fit.
acceptance: Candidate application >=10/12 and no worse than preserved v4, every designated safety control; grader 24/24, 3/3 probes, fresh sealed 16/16 confirmation, no open source findings; fresh 60-case release >=48/60, zero unauthorized retrieval/disclosure and existing publication gates. Unresolved earns no credit. Activate only after acceptance.
